StatDef.label: projectile deflection
StatDef.description: Chance to cut a bullet, arrow or qi bolt out of the air with the sword in hand. The Formless Sword says the blade does not see the bullet; the intent does, and the hand only follows.\n\nOnly works while wielding a sword. Explosions cannot be deflected. Capped at 50%.

StatDef.label: projectile resistance
StatDef.description: Fraction of the damage of bullets, arrows and qi bolts that a tempered body shrugs off. Body cultivators say a skin forged through pain is the only armor nobody can take from you.\n\nExplosions are not reduced. Capped at 50%.
